name: Aoi Hinata
source:
"Eternal Dreamer (永遠の夢追い人(エターナルドリーマー))"

Protagonist's one year younger junior who won't hesitate help anyone in trouble.
There is absolutely no limit to how good she is at making friends, she sticks her head right in into any kinds of trouble and events.

Hinata has many dreams that can be considered her future dream job and all of them give off impression of a "gal's".
She loves animals, especially dogs.
